title: Original median-polish workflow
text: fit_workflow(..., workflow = "median_polish") follows original hit-determination steps: Build promoter_libplate_replicate = paste(reporter, libplate, replicate, sep = "_"). Compute DMSO mean normalized response within reporter-libplate-replicate group. Compute log2FC = normalized.lux - avg.dmso.expression. Form matrix reporter-libplate-replicate groups rows srn_code perturbation/library wells columns. Apply stats::medpolish(..., na.rm = TRUE, maxiter = 1000, eps = 1e-8). Use median-polish residuals log2FC.polished. Estimate DMSO residual mean standard deviation within reporter-libplate-replicate group. Compute zscore = (log2FC.polished - dmso.avg_dmsoFC) / dmso.stdv_dmsoFC. Compute two-sided Gaussian p-values. hit calling, remove DMSO/noisy-DMSO wells, keep largest p-value across replicates reporter-perturbation pair, apply BH correction within reporter. normality = TRUE, function also runs workflow’s DMSO normality screen median polishing. Lilliefors test uses nortest::lillie.test(); install nortest set normality_methods = "shapiro" Shapiro-Wilk check needed.

title: Salmonella Empty Vector workflow
text: fit_workflow(..., workflow = "empty_vector_control") follows original Salmonella hit-determination logic: Remove noisy DMSO wells failed reporters, example PmgrR. Keep already centered response column, usually log2.lux.normed.centered. srn_code, compute average PEVC3 response across PEVC3 replicates. Compute log.evcfc = expression_value - average_PEVC3_expression_for_srn_code. Remove PEVC3 reference rows tested reporter table. Gather DMSO log.evcfc values within reporter-replicate group. Estimate dmso.mean dmso.stdv. Compute zscore = (log.evcfc - dmso.mean) / dmso.stdv. Compute two-sided Gaussian p-values. Retain largest replicate-level p-value reporter-perturbation pair. Apply BH correction within reporter label hits.
